enrollments_fee_override_has_reason.name: enrollments_fee_override_has_reason
enrollments_fee_override_has_reason.value: "enrollments"."fee_override_cents" IS NULL OR "enrollments"."reason" IS NOT NULL

import_jobs_finished_has_time.name: import_jobs_finished_has_time
import_jobs_finished_has_time.value: "import_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('done', 'failed') OR "import_jobs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

invoice_lines_void_reason.name: invoice_lines_void_reason
invoice_lines_void_reason.value: ("invoice_lines"."voided_at" is null and "invoice_lines"."void_reason" is null) or ("invoice_lines"."voided_at" is not null and char_length("invoice_lines"."void_reason") >= 3)

payments_reversal_sign.name: payments_reversal_sign
payments_reversal_sign.value: ("payments"."method" = 'reversal' and "payments"."amount_cents" <= 0 and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" <> "payments"."id") or ("payments"."method" <> 'reversal' and "payments"."amount_cents" >= 0 and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null)

payments_surplus_bounds.name: payments_surplus_bounds
payments_surplus_bounds.value: "payments"."unallocated_cents" between 0 and abs("payments"."amount_cents") and ("payments"."method" in ('card', 'reversal') or "payments"."unallocated_cents" = 0)

sessions_revoked_reason_needs_revoked_at.name: sessions_revoked_reason_needs_revoked_at
sessions_revoked_reason_needs_revoked_at.value: "sessions"."revoked_reason" IS NULL OR "sessions"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

staff_invites_has_contact.name: staff_invites_has_contact
staff_invites_has_contact.value: "staff_invites"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "staff_invites"."email" IS NOT NULL

staff_invites_accepted_has_user.name: staff_invites_accepted_has_user
staff_invites_accepted_has_user.value: "staff_invites"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "staff_invites"."accepted_user_id" IS NOT NULL

students_under18_has_consent.name: students_under18_has_consent
students_under18_has_consent.value: NOT "students"."under18" OR ("students"."consent_given_by" IS NOT NULL AND "students"."consent_method" IS NOT NULL AND "students"."consent_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL)

tenant_users_has_identifier.name: tenant_users_has_identifier
tenant_users_has_identifier.value: "tenant_users"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "tenant_users"."email" IS NOT NULL
